poster.purpose: One figure per page at most: the 90% of the home statement band, the phase numeral, the 404.

hero.purpose: The home headline only; from 68em two lines across the page, never taller than the window lets them be.

statement.purpose: Large statements, and the wide form of a page title.

banner.purpose: Standard page titles and the one-sentence statement of a section.

page.purpose: The heading of a shelf of content.

section.purpose: Section headings and large row labels.

copy.purpose: Body copy and the body default, at most 36rem wide.

ui.purpose: Buttons, links in the bar and field labels.

eyebrow.purpose: The uppercase label over a heading.

shadows.name: depth-0
shadows.purpose: A hairline ring: a sheet lying flat.

shadows.name: depth-1
shadows.purpose: A thumbnail or a tab: cover thumbnails, phase tabs on the rail, the sheets under a stack, the parts of a folder behind its front.

shadows.name: depth-2
shadows.purpose: An object at rest: the default sheet and the front of a folder.

shadows.name: depth-3
shadows.purpose: Lifted, or a panel, below 68em: the raised column of the comparison, the front of a page-size folder, a lifted sheet.

shadows.name: depth-4
shadows.purpose: The top of a stack below 68em: the navigation drawer, the filter sheet and the pop-up of the catalog.

shadows.name: bar-shadow
shadows.purpose: Under the sticky bar; it arrives over the first 84px of scroll.

motion.name: time-swap
motion.purpose: Colour changes on controls, links and rows; the 3px move of an arrow. Linear.

motion.name: time-enter
motion.purpose: A small element entering: the filter sheet rising, the wait before a tally fills.

motion.name: time-exit
motion.purpose: The scrim behind the drawer and the pop-up fading in.

motion.name: time-fill
motion.purpose: One block of a tally filling.

motion.name: time-blink
motion.purpose: One cycle of the caret in a blank; it blinks three times.

motion.name: time-lift
motion.purpose: A sheet lifting under the pointer or focus; folder sheets rising; the bar's underline sliding.

motion.name: time-count
motion.purpose: A counter, and the wheel of the 90% figure.

motion.name: time-page-out
motion.purpose: The first block of the outgoing page.

motion.name: time-page-in
motion.purpose: The first block of the incoming page, after 80ms.

motion.name: time-morph
motion.purpose: A cover or folder given a slug travelling between two pages.

motion.name: stagger
motion.purpose: The delay between siblings in an entrance.

motion.name: curve-settle
motion.purpose: The default ease for entrances, lifts and the drawer.

motion.name: curve-leave
motion.purpose: The first-load cover leaving; the hero's box dissolving.

motion.name: curve-ink
motion.purpose: Ink-in entrances and the incoming page.

motion.name: curve-drop
motion.purpose: The small overshoot of a settling sheet and of the hero's documents landing.

motion.name: curve-pen
motion.purpose: The pen strokes of the logo on the first-load cover.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main move on a page: solid ink that takes the highlighter inside its ink border under the pointer or focus, and goes one step deeper while pressed.

components.name: Text Input
components.description: A paper field 48px tall with a 2px firm rule border that darkens under the pointer and turns to ink on focus.

components.css: .ds-input { display: block; width: 100%; max-width: 22rem; height: var(--control); padding: 0 var(--s-2); border: var(--edge) solid var(--rule-firm); border-radius: var(--round-2); background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--face-text); font-size: var(--size-ui); line-height: 1.375; font-weight: 400; appearance: none; transition: border-color var(--time-swap) linear; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--ink-faint); opacity: 1; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--ink-soft); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--ink); outline: 3px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-input:disabled { border-color: var(--rule); background: var(--desk-deep); color: var(--ink-faint); cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Checkbox
components.description: A filter row: a 21px box that takes the highlighter, an ink border and an ink tick when checked, with a faint count at the end of the row.
components.css: .ds-check { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--s-2); min-height: var(--tap); max-width: 16rem; color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--face-text); font-size: var(--size-ui); line-height: 1.375; font-weight: 600; } .ds-check-input { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; margin: 0; opacity: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-check-box { display: grid; flex: none; place-items: center; width: var(--s-3); height: var(--s-3); border: var(--edge) solid var(--rule-firm); border-radius: var(--round-1); background: var(--paper); transition: background-color var(--time-swap) linear, border-color var(--time-swap) linear; } .ds-check-tick { color: var(--ink); visibility: hidden; } .ds-check-count { margin-inline-start: auto; color: var(--ink-faint); font-size: var(--size-note); font-weight: 400; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums; } .ds-check-input:checked + .ds-check-box { border-color: var(--ink); background: var(--mark); } .ds-check-input:checked + .ds-check-box .ds-check-tick { visibility: visible; } .ds-check:hover .ds-check-input:not(:checked) + .ds-check-box { border-color: var(--ink-soft); } .ds-check:hover .ds-check-input:checked + .ds-check-box { background: var(--mark-deep); } .ds-check-input:focus-visible + .ds-check-box { outline: 3px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Tags
components.description: The format tag (paper, a 1px ink border, uppercase 12px) and the saving tag (the highlighter with its ink ring, 14px at weight 700), which reads "Free sample" on a free template.

components.name: Primary Navigation
components.description: Catalog and About in the desktop bar, set wide apart: soft-ink text, a wash on hover and focus, and the current page in ink under one 2px ink line that slides from link to link.

• Catalog

components.name: Phase Rail

components.name: Paper Sheet

Template

Stakeholder Communications Plan
components.css: .ds-sheet { position: relative; isolation: isolate; display: grid; gap: var(--s-2); max-width: 20rem; padding: var(--s-3); border-radius: var(--round-1); box-shadow: var(--depth-2); color: var(--ink); transition: translate var(--time-lift) var(--curve-settle); } .ds-sheet::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; border-radius: inherit; background: var(--grain) 0 0 / 8rem 8rem, radial-gradient(farthest-corner at 14% 8%, var(--paper), var(--paper-shade)); } .ds-sheet::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; border-radius: inherit; box-shadow: var(--depth-3); opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transition: opacity var(--time-lift) var(--curve-settle); } .ds-sheet:hover { translate: 0 -6px; } .ds-sheet:hover::after { opacity: 1; } .ds-sheet-eyebrow { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--s-1); margin: 0; font-family: var(--face-text); font-size: var(--size-eyebrow); line-height: 1.385; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-sheet-eyebrow::before { content: ""; flex: none; width: 9px; height: 9px; border: var(--hair) solid var(--ink); background: var(--mark); } .ds-sheet-title { margin: 0; font-family: var(--face-display); font-size: var(--size-section); line-height: 1.24; font-weight: 600; font-feature-settings: "tnum" 0; } .ds-blank { position: relative; display: block; height: var(--s-5); border: var(--edge) solid var(--ink); border-radius: var(--round-2); background: var(--mark); } .ds-blank-caret { position: absolute; inset-block: 25%; left: var(--s-2); width: var(--edge); background: var(--ink); } .ds-tally { display: flex; gap: var(--s-1); } .ds-tally i { flex: 1; height: var(--s-2); border-radius: var(--round-1); } .ds-tally-ink { background: var(--ink); } .ds-tally-mark { background: var(--mark); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 var(--edge) var(--ink); }

components.name: Folder
components.description: The toolkit as a folder: a wash tab, white sheets standing in a back panel, and a wash front panel. The sheets rise 14, 10 and 6px under the pointer. At page size it holds the covers of the six free samples, has a card-stock front that casts a shade onto them, and carries the price on a paper tag hung from its corner.
components.html:
The complete toolkit

Seven phases in one folder.

One purchase

components.name: Template Tile
components.description: A template in the catalog grid: its cover in a square well, then phase, title and format. A free sample is a link with a "Free sample" tag; every other template is locked, its cover blurred under two steel chains and a padlock, and pressing it outlines the tile in the alert red, shakes it and says "Included with the toolkit."

components.css: .ds-ledger { max-width: 32rem; margin: 0; padding: 0; border-block-end: var(--hair) solid var(--rule); list-style: none; } .ds-ledger-row { padding: var(--s-2) 0; border-block-start: var(--hair) solid var(--rule); } .ds-rowlink { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--s-2); min-height: var(--control-lg); margin: calc(-1 * var(--s-2)); padding: var(--s-2); border-radius: var(--round-2); color: var(--ink); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color var(--time-swap) linear; } .ds-rowlink-text { display: flex; flex: 1; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; } .ds-rowlink-label { font-family: var(--face-display); font-size: var(--size-item); line-height: 1.3; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: underline transparent; text-decoration-thickness: var(--edge); text-underline-offset: 3px; transition: text-decoration-color var(--time-swap) linear; } .ds-rowlink-caption { color: var(--ink-faint); font-family: var(--face-text); font-size: var(--size-note); line-height: 1.43; } .ds-rowlink-trailing { font-family: var(--face-text); font-size: var(--size-ui); line-height: 1.375; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums; } .ds-rowlink-arrow { flex: none; transition: translate var(--time-swap) linear; } .ds-rowlink:hover, .ds-rowlink:focus-visible, .ds-rowlink:active { background: var(--mark-wash); } .ds-rowlink:hover .ds-rowlink-label, .ds-rowlink:focus-visible .ds-rowlink-label { text-decoration-color: currentColor; } .ds-rowlink:hover .ds-rowlink-arrow, .ds-rowlink:focus-visible .ds-rowlink-arrow { translate: 3px 0; } .ds-rowlink:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: calc(-1 * var(--s-1)); }

narrative.overview:
The site is a desk with documents on it. White sheets of paper lie on a cool grey desk, set in near-black type, and one light-blue highlighter marks the parts that belong to the buyer: the blank still to fill, the tenth block of ten, the phase they are on. Everything the system draws is an object from that desk. A sheet has a tooth, a light on it and a layered shadow. A folder has a tab and sheets standing in it. Phases are index tabs, lists are ledgers ruled with hairlines, and progress is a tally of blocks. The site sells one thing, the complete toolkit, and it is the folder on the desk with its price on a paper tag: six sample templates lie open on the desk, and every other template hangs behind a steel chain and a padlock.

Ink is the one material that moves. A real-time simulation of ink in water runs behind the first screen, the 90% statement, the closing band, the Purchase page, wide page titles, the 404 and the footer. It lies on the ground of a band and never on a sheet, it is held back around every block of text, and its strength is capped against the ground the copy is read on. The rest of the motion is small and physical: a sheet settles as it scrolls into view, rises 6px and tilts up to 1.2 degrees toward the pointer, a rule is drawn from the left, and a first visit opens on a blank page where the logo is signed stroke by stroke, the small 365 on its arm last. The first screen then acts out the tagline: an empty prompt box, a black drop and a blue one, and the six free samples standing where the box was.

The density is that of a document, not of a dashboard: reading-width columns, a twelve-column grid from 68em, bands 56 to 112px deep, and type that carries the hierarchy before colour or depth add anything. The system has a light scheme only. Under reduced motion, raised contrast, forced colours, no JavaScript or no WebGL2 the page is complete: still images stand in for the ink, shadows give way to ink lines, and nothing waits hidden.
keyCharacteristics: Paper objects on a desk: sheets, stacks, folders, index tabs and ledgers, each with a real edge and a real shadow.
Three inks: near-black for what is written, light blue for what is the buyer's, and a dark binder ground for the footer and the statement bands.
The highlighter always comes with ink (a border, a ring, a tick or the text itself) and is never a text colour on a light ground.
Two typefaces with fixed jobs: a slab serif for the documents and their figures, a hyperlegible sans for the store.
A 7px module for every space, two breakpoints (40em and 68em) for every layout.
Live ink in water as the showpiece, always beneath the text, always pausable, with a still image for every case where it cannot run.
Movement only inside the no-preference motion query. Bands and surfaces change ground with a hard edge and never fade.

rules.name: The Mark Carries Ink Rule
rules.body: The highlighter fill is never the only signal. On paper it measures 1.89 : 1, too pale to be seen alone, so every marked thing also has an ink border, an inset ink ring, an ink tick or a heavier weight of ink text.

rules.name: The Background Only Rule
rules.body: On a light ground the highlighter is a background behind ink text and never a text, icon or line colour. Only on the binder, where it measures 10.11 : 1, does it become a line: the focus ring and the underline of a hovered link.

rules.name: The Band Decides Rule
rules.body: Components read eleven semantic names (`ground`, `surface`, `stripe`, `tile`, `text`, `text-soft`, `text-faint`, `line`, `line-firm`, `line-ink`, `focus-ring`) and never a raw colour. Each band (`desk`, `paper`, `wash`, `ink`, `binder`) redefines them, and a sheet or a folder front resets them to the paper values, so one component is correct on every ground.

rules.name: The Light Fill Rule
rules.body: The wash and the highlighter are light on every band. While one of them is the fill of a hovered or current element, everything inside reads the ink colours, whatever the band says.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Besley is for what a document says: headings, figures, prices, numerals on tabs and tiles. Atkinson Hyperlegible Next is for everything the store says. A component never mixes them inside one line of text.

rules.name: The Small Is Loud Rule
rules.body: The two sizes under 14px are always uppercase, weight 700 and tracked. The text in the markup stays in sentence case; the capitals are drawn by the style.

rules.name: The Own Figures Rule
rules.body: Display type keeps Besley's own lining figures and turns tabular figures off, because its tabular zero is drawn thin from weight 600 up. Columns of numbers in the text face use tabular lining figures.

rules.name: The No Tracking Rule
rules.body: Letter spacing is 0 at every size from 14px up. Hierarchy comes from size, weight and face.

rules.name: The Second Shadow Rule
rules.body: No shadow is ever animated. An object that lifts carries its lifted shadow on a pseudo-element from the start, and only that layer's opacity moves.

rules.name: The Rest And Lift Rule
rules.body: A sheet's lifted shadow is one step above its resting one and never lower than depth 3. Only a sheet marked as lit lifts, 6px, under the pointer on a device that hovers and under keyboard focus inside it.

rules.name: The Ink Line Fallback Rule
rules.body: At raised contrast every shadow gives way to a 1px ink border, and in forced colours to a system border. An object is never defined by its shadow alone.

dos: Do pair every highlighter fill with ink: a 2px inset ring, an ink border, a tick or weight 700 text.
Do put a band under everything, and let the band set the colours through the semantic names.
Do present a thing as a paper object (a sheet, a stack, a folder, a cover) or as a row on a hairline.
Do take every space from the 7px module and every layout change from the two breakpoints, 40em and 68em.
Do set documents, figures and prices in Besley at 600 to 800, and everything the store says in Atkinson Hyperlegible Next.
Do make hover and keyboard focus look the same, and give a press the same answer, so a finger gets what a pointer gets.
Do keep every target at least 44px tall below 68em, and show the 3px focus ring 3px off the element.
Do place ink on the ground of a band, mark every text block over it as a calm zone, and name a still for it.
Do keep every animation inside the no-preference motion query, with the finished state as the default.
Do give an object an ink line where its shadow is removed, at raised contrast and in forced colours.
donts: Don't use the highlighter as a text, icon or line colour on a light ground, or as a fill with no ink beside it.
Don't introduce another accent. The palette is white, near-black and one light blue; the red is for errors and a locked tile's refusal only.
Don't build a boxed card with a border and a large radius. Corners are 3px on paper and 6px on controls.
Don't fade, slide or blend a band or a surface. Grounds change with a hard edge.
Don't animate a shadow, a layout property or a custom property, and don't loop an animation.
Don't let a state change alter a size: borders are always present and rings are drawn inside.
Don't place ink on a sheet, inside a panel or behind body copy that has no calm zone, and don't run a second canvas.
Don't set type smaller than 14px unless it is uppercase, weight 700 and tracked, and don't track anything larger.
Don't add a dark scheme or a query for one. The system declares a light scheme only.
Don't hide content in a starting state that a script has to undo. Without the script, nothing is missing.
